entries.chinese: 待辦事項有點長，先把茶沖好。
entries.english: A long list. A properly brewed cup first.

entries.chinese: 這頁沒有塗歪，只是風有點大。
entries.english: The line isn't crooked. It caught a little breeze.

entries.chinese: 今天的靈感，躲在餅乾罐裡。
entries.english: Today's bright idea is hiding in the biscuit tin.

entries.chinese: 空白也佔一頁，算我有寫。
entries.english: A blank page still counts as a page.

entries.chinese: 窗邊那片光，值得留一小格。
entries.english: Leave a little square for the light by the window.

entries.chinese: 把路上看見的藍，帶回這一頁。
entries.english: Bring the blue you noticed home to this page.

entries.chinese: 今天普通的一刻，明天可能很珍貴。
entries.english: An ordinary moment today may be a treasure tomorrow.

entries.chinese: 先收下一片葉，再想故事的名字。
entries.english: Keep the leaf. Let the story find its name.

entries.chinese: 不用寫滿，寫下第一行就好。
entries.english: No need to fill the page. Start with one line.

entries.chinese: 記下最小的一步，給它一個位置。
entries.english: Give the smallest next step a place on the page.

entries.chinese: 做完一件小事，再畫一個小圈。
entries.english: One small thing done. One little circle drawn.

entries.chinese: 今天能做多少，就從那裡開始。
entries.english: Begin with what you can do today.

entries.chinese: 願你回家時，還有一盞暖燈。
entries.english: May a warm light be waiting when you get home.

entries.chinese: 願今天的茶，剛好不燙口。
entries.english: May today's tea be just cool enough to sip.

entries.chinese: 願忙碌之間，有一小段自己的時間。
entries.english: May there be a little time that is yours between busy moments.

entries.chinese: 願這頁收好一件小小的好事。
entries.english: May this page keep one small good thing.

entries.chinese: 這一頁，由我決定怎樣留下。
entries.english: I decide what this page will keep.

entries.chinese: 我可以把沒做完的事，留到明天。
entries.english: I can leave unfinished things for tomorrow.

entries.chinese: 我的字不必整齊，故事也值得被記下。
entries.english: My story belongs here, even when my letters wander.

entries.chinese: 我可以歇一會，再翻下一頁。
entries.english: I can rest a little before the next page.
